card.name: Was/been after drug use, before 'associated'
card.fires_on: The helper verb 'was' or 'been' right after a phrase like 'use of [drug]' or 'maternal use of [drug]', where 'associated with' is expected next.

modes.label: was after use of drug
modes.description: 'was' follows a subject like 'maternal use of paroxetine' and leads into 'associated with' a risk.
modes.example: found that maternal use of paroxetine during the first trimester of pregnancy<< was>> associated with a 2- to

modes.label: has been after drug class
modes.description: 'been' follows 'Use of [drug class], including X, has' in warning sections, before 'associated with' an adverse event.
modes.example: Use of TNF blockers, including infliximab products, has<< been>> associated with reactivation of hepatitis B virus

card.writes: It raises the word 'associated' and related forms as the next word.
card.plain: It spots the spot after 'use of a drug was/has been' where the text is about to say 'associated with' a risk.
